The problem statement says "find the minimal sum of a sub-array" and clarifies that sub-array means contiguous elements.  
The most important ambiguity is whether the minimal sum can be negative (i.e., if we’re looking for the smallest possible sum, which could be very negative if there are negative numbers) or if we’re looking for the smallest positive sum (which would be different).  
Question 7 directly addresses whether "minimal sum" means the most negative sum possible, which changes the algorithm from "find the smallest positive sum" (trivial if all positive) to "find the minimum subarray sum" (which can be negative and is a known algorithmic problem).  

ANSWER: 7
